next.reason: 1985: 'Subscripting associated with any identifier is evaluated only once as the first operation'. §2023:14.9.22.4 GR6: 'Item identification for any identifier is done only once as the first operation'; item identification adds 'length evaluation for an occurs-depending group item' (§2023:14.6.4 GR6) to subscripts and reference modification (§2023:14.6.4 GR4, GR7). For a format 3 INSPECT, 1985 evaluates identifier-1's ODO length again for the replacing part (two successive statements); 2023 fixes it at the first operation, so a tally into the DEPENDING ON item yields a different result.
